notes.title: The Playtest Is Live!
notes.notes:
• Weigh heigh and welcome to the official launch of Crazy Captain Cannon Mission: Billionaire Buster!
• Our goal is to make it the best cannon-based game of all-time, and we need your help. 
• We need your feedback and comments so please give us yours. All comments will be read by the game developers.
• CCC-MBB is MORE than a game - visit [url=https://crazycaptaincannon.com]https://crazycaptaincannon.com[/url] to become a crew member today.
• Join our Discord to provide feedback or ask any questions you may have here: [url=https://discord.gg/DqfGxms4rd]https://discord.gg/DqfGxms4rd[/url]

Cheers to the Commoners!
